system.description:
Range 60ft.

  • An invisible wall of 10ft square per level, or a sphere or hemisphere of radius 1ft per two levels, lasts 1 round per level.
  • Nothing passes through, including breath weapons and spells; it is immune to damage and Dispel Magic.
  • Only Disintegrate or Wish destroys it.
  • It blocks Ethereal creatures; anyone caught as it forms may save (Reflex) to pick a side.

Classes: Wizard, Sorcerer
system.saveEffect: Picks which side of the wall it is on
